canonical_name: full singular value decomposition for finite real or complex rectangular matrices
literal_source_claim_zh: 任意矩阵可分解为UΣV*形式
literal_source_claim_en: Every matrix can be decomposed in U Sigma V* form.
canonical_statement: Every finite rectangular real or complex matrix has a full singular value decomposition into square orthogonal or unitary left and right factors and a conforming rectangular diagonal factor with nonnegative real diagonal entries.
canonical_claim: For each finite m-by-n matrix A over R or C, there exist square orthogonal or unitary matrices U and V and an m-by-n rectangular diagonal matrix Sigma with nonnegative real diagonal entries such that A = U * Sigma * V*.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no source citation, scalar field, dimensions, factor shapes, unitary convention, rectangular-diagonal definition, ordering, zero-padding, star convention, or empty-dimension policy, and THM-M-1449 is a likely unresolved duplicate. Before accepting an exact Lean target, the statement phase must admit and independently review a pinpoint source, reconcile the duplicate, ratify every convention, then elaborate, fingerprint, transport, and mutation-test the result.
domain_and_universes: Intake-selected family: arbitrary finite row and column index types m and n and scalar k equal to R or C (possibly via RCLike), with A : Matrix m n k. Exact universes, decidable-equality and fintype binders, and whether real and complex cases share one root remain for the statement gate.
quantifiers: k: real or complex scalar field
m: arbitrary finite row index type
n: arbitrary finite column index type
A: arbitrary matrix m-by-n over k
existential U, V, and Sigma of source-selected shapes
ordered_binders: forall k and its real-or-complex field structure
forall finite row and column index types m and n
forall A : Matrix m n k
there exist U : Matrix m m k, V : Matrix n n k, and Sigma : Matrix m n k
hypotheses: k is R or C, provisionally represented by an RCLike field
m and n are finite and have decidable equality
conclusion: U and V satisfy the selected orthogonal/unitary predicates; Sigma is rectangular diagonal with nonnegative real diagonal entries under the selected indexing convention; and A = U * Sigma * V* exactly.
degenerate_case_status: Empty row and column types and the zero matrix are provisionally included; no Nonempty, positive-dimension, full-rank, or invertibility premise is added. The statement phase must ratify and mutation-test every boundary described in scope-map.md.
